bosses.name: The Keep Warden
bosses.telegraph: The Warden's cleaver has kept this hall for a hundred years. It does not intend to stop tonight.
bosses.description: A towering brute that guards the ruined keep.

bosses.name: The Crystal Sorcerer
bosses.telegraph: The Sorcerer bows, courteous as glass. Every facet of the chamber bows back.
bosses.description: A mage who weaves ice and venom in the crystal depths.

bosses.name: The Hollow Commander
bosses.telegraph: The Commander raises one hand, and the whole wood holds its breath.
bosses.description: A cunning leader who fights amid a loyal warband.

bosses.name: The Endless Tyrant
bosses.telegraph: The Tyrant does not walk into battle. The Tyrant arrives.
bosses.description: A tyrant who throws wave upon wave of minions.

bosses.name: The Deep King

triggers.text: The Deep King plants its crown and digs in.

bosses.telegraph: The Deep King wears a crown nobody gave it, in a hall nobody leaves.
bosses.description: A crowned colossus that rules the deepest crystal seams.

bosses.name: The Blight Matron
bosses.telegraph: The Matron smiles like something long out of practice. Spores drift wherever she looks.
bosses.description: A plague-witch who festers in the hollow wood.

bosses.name: The Sand Warlord

triggers.text: The Warlord whips the storm into every eye!

bosses.telegraph: The Warlord travels inside its own private sandstorm. Today the weather is for war.
bosses.description: A brute chieftain who rules the second town's approaches.

bosses.name: The Frost Monarch

triggers.text: The cracks across the Monarch freeze into a perfect mirror.

bosses.telegraph: The Monarch has sat frozen on this throne for an age. It finds your arrival refreshing.
bosses.description: A frozen sovereign who silences all who trespass.

bosses.name: The Obsidian Colossus

triggers.text: The blow rings back up the attacker's arms.

bosses.telegraph: The Colossus stood here before the town had a name. It intends to outlast the visit.
bosses.description: A living mountain of black glass.

bosses.name: The Hollow Sovereign
bosses.telegraph: The Sovereign's crown is older than its bones. Its host kneels without being asked.
bosses.description: A crowned revenant leading a loyal host.

bosses.name: The Abyssal Tyrant

triggers.text: The Tyrant howls over its fallen and comes on faster.

bosses.telegraph: The Tyrant counts its followers fondly, the way a miser counts coin.
bosses.description: A relentless warlord who throws wave upon wave.

bosses.name: The Dread Sovereign
bosses.telegraph: The Dread Sovereign has already decided how this evening ends. It is seldom wrong.
bosses.description: The seventh town's dread ruler, master of every affliction.

bosses.name: The Gray Gander
bosses.telegraph: The Gander unfolds to its full height. The pond goes very quiet.
bosses.description: The oldest goose on the water, and the angriest.

bosses.name: The Mother of Ponds
bosses.telegraph: The Mother counts her goslings. You are not one of them.
bosses.description: Every pond answers to somebody. They answer to her.

bosses.name: The Pondlord
bosses.telegraph: The Pondlord surveys its reeds like a general. The reeds salute.
bosses.description: A waterfowl with territorial ambitions and the beak to back them.

bosses.name: The Hollow King

triggers.text: The King hums an old cradle-song, and the whole hall grows heavy-lidded.

bosses.telegraph: The Hollow King rises. The court holds its breath, and the candles lean away from him.
bosses.description: The sovereign of the castle above the seven towns - the hardest foe in the realm. Fought only in his throne room; his regalia is won nowhere else.

bosses.name: The Deadly Duck

triggers.text: The Duck serves the whole party their final notice. Everything stops.
A blizzard of impossibly soft down bursts loose. The whole party drifts off.

bosses.telegraph: The Deadly Duck surfaces without a single ripple. The pond pretends not to notice.
bosses.description: The terror beneath the pond, mightier than the Hollow King himself. The geese speak of him only in whispers. Fought nowhere but Goose Town.

bosses.name: Foreman Brakk, the First Chair

triggers.text: The Foreman folds his coat over the chair. Now it is a real interview.

bosses.telegraph: The great chair creaks under a man who has denied stronger applicants than you.
bosses.description: Town 1's Guild Master. Every membership in the realm began with his signature, and he has never once needed a second pen.

bosses.name: Auditor Vess, the Red Quill

triggers.text: The Quill strikes a line through every incantation on the page.

bosses.telegraph: Auditor Vess opens your file. It is thicker than you remember living.
bosses.description: Town 2's Guild Master. Audits reserves of gold, of magic, and of nerve, in that order.

bosses.name: Chain-Mistress Karga

triggers.text: The chain snaps taut around the last wrist that dared.

bosses.telegraph: Chain-Mistress Karga measures your ankles by eye. Old habit, she says.
bosses.description: Town 3's Guild Master. Collections used to be a department. Now it is a person.

bosses.name: Warden Mole, Keeper of Keys

triggers.text: A lock the attacker never saw clicks shut around the moment.
The Warden turns the third key. The door of him closes.

bosses.telegraph: Warden Mole does not look up. The keys around his neck do.
bosses.description: Town 4's Guild Master. Nobody knows what the vault under the guild holds. Warden Mole is why.

bosses.name: The Cutlery Curator

triggers.text: The Curator raises a soup spoon to exactly the wrong angle. Or exactly the right one.
A drawer of mismatched forks opens somewhere. The clatter is indescribable.

bosses.telegraph: The Curator inventories your party at a glance: four entries, one regrettable.
bosses.description: Town 5's Guild Master. Keeps the guild's collection of significant utensils, and will not say which one is THE spoon.

bosses.name: Grandmaster Ossia, the Tenth Seat

triggers.text: Ossia bows to the fallen, then stops being polite.
One look from the Tenth Seat, and the arm remembers fear.

bosses.telegraph: Grandmaster Ossia has retired undefeated nine times. This chair is the tenth.
bosses.description: Town 6's Guild Master. The nine previous chairs are kept polished, empty, and slightly afraid.

bosses.name: Registrar Null, the Final Ledger

triggers.text: Null underlines each of your names once. The ink does not dry so much as arrive.
The Registrar turns a page. The margin narrows.

bosses.telegraph: Registrar Null closes the ledger. Yours was the last open entry.
bosses.description: Town 7's Guild Master. Every account settles eventually. Registrar Null is the eventually.

bosses.name: The Last Dragon
bosses.basicAttackText: The Dragon's breath catches. It lunges instead.

triggers.text: The Dragon inhales, and every incantation in the room goes with it.
What remains of the Dragon stops pretending to be slow.
The Dragon refuses arithmetic: where one ending stood, now there are two.

bosses.telegraph: The Last Dragon opens one eye. It has been saving this nap for a century, and you are the reason it ends.
bosses.description: The King's nemesis, and the reason the crown is so tired. Twelve curios wake it. Nothing puts it back down but you.
